PRODUCTION CONSISTENCY CONTRACT (applies to every asset): Declare exact output canvas dimensions, equal cell dimensions when using a sprite grid, intended in-scene footprint, fixed projection/camera, light direction, pixel-cluster density and outline weight matching the scene reference. For scenes/UI/items, explicitly preserve aspect ratio, safe area, optical size, border thickness and reference pixel density across variants. Backgrounds fill all edges; UI nine-slice corners remain fixed; no baked-in labels or text. Inspect transition between idle and interaction, NOT just individual sheets. Size/anchor/style mismatch means reject and regenerate; a successful HTTP response is not visual approval. For visitors entering or leaving a scene, create an explicit approach/peek/emerge/settle sequence and a physically occluded exit. Start and end the complete loop in the SAME hidden state. Specify separate entry and exit directions: never replace entrance with reversed exit, fading, scaling, or a cut from invisible to a fully visible idle character. Validate the loop boundary as carefully as individual frames.
